CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
   D. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Call of Disciples? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Call of Disciples.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
